limitation: Open article text supports reported Israeli-intelligence lineage and aircraft-security decision context; anonymous official sourcing and limited access do not prove plot feasibility or institutional intelligence confidence.
observation: WSJ reports that U.S. officials received Israeli intelligence about a possible plot to kill Trump, and that defensive-capability concerns aboard the new plane led Trump to fly home from Turkey aboard an older Air Force One; WSJ also reports some officials deemed the threat not entirely credible.
